raw_text: Wagner/Africa Corps has set up new camps near Libya's biggest oil export terminal. This is basically Russia securing energy infrastructure in north Africa while the world is focused on Ukraine. The post-Prigozhin reorganization seems to be centralizing PMC operations under GRU control. Does anyone know what Haftar's LNA thinks about this expansion?
